chain.label: In-service inspection program lacked redundant NDT methods
chain.trigger: the lack of sufficient redundancy in the in-service inspection program

chain.label: Drill breakage/chip packing during Volvo's manufacture of the tierod hole
chain.trigger: some form of drill breakage or drill breakdown, combined with localized loss of coolant and chip packing, occurred during the drilling process, creating the altered microstructure and ladder cracking

chain.label: Altered microstructure with ladder cracking (fatigue-crack origin) in tierod hole wall
chain.trigger: an area of altered microstructure that was created during the drilling process...and that went undetected at the time of manufacture

caused_by.evidence: creating the altered microstructure and ladder cracking in the accident hub

chain.label: Volvo's BEA/visual inspection failed to flag the defect as rejectable
chain.trigger: Volvo did not identify it as rejectable because the appearance of the tierod hole did not match any of the existing inspection templates showing rejectable conditions

caused_by.evidence: although the altered microstructure in the accident hub tierod hole was detectable by BEA inspection methods, Volvo did not identify it as rejectable

chain.label: Delta's FPI process failed to detect the now-1.36-inch fatigue crack during the October 1995 overhaul
chain.trigger: the failure of Delta Air Lines' fluorescent penetrant inspection process to detect a detectable fatigue crack

caused_by.evidence: the crack was large enough to have been detectable during the accident hub's last FPI at Delta

chain.label: Left engine fan hub fractured circumferentially during the initial takeoff roll
chain.trigger: the probable cause of this accident was the fracture of the left engine's front compressor fan hub

caused_by.evidence: fatigue cracks initiated from the ladder cracking in the tierod hole and began propagating almost immediately after the hub was put into service in 1990
resulted from the failure of Delta Air Lines' fluorescent penetrant inspection process to detect a detectable fatigue crack
Contributing to the accident was the lack of sufficient redundancy in the in-service inspection program

chain.label: Uncontained engine debris penetrated the fuselage, killing two passengers and seriously injuring two others
chain.trigger: Uncontained engine debris...penetrated the left aft fuselage. Two passengers were killed and two others were seriously injured.

caused_by.evidence: Uncontained engine debris from the front compressor front hub...of the No. 1 (left) engine penetrated the left aft fuselage
